content:
The City of Laredo Environmental Services Department is asking residents to give their sprinklers a break. After about five inches of rain fell across Laredo over the past few days, the department says now is the time to turn irrigation systems off for the next week or two.

With the ground already soaked, watering lawns wastes water — and money. Shutting off sprinklers also helps prevent runoff, the department said in a public service announcement posted Monday morning.

The message is simple: let the rain do the watering for now, and switch irrigation back on once things dry out.

Source: City of Laredo Environmental Services, Facebook, November 9, 2026.

title: City to Laredo: Turn Off Irrigation After Days of Rain
